node.n01_leszallas.title: Landing on Ebony Moon
node.n01_leszallas.text:
Kestrel’s landing gear grinds into the −160 °C crust of EH-3, Ebony Moon. Varga’s red bands hang above the horizon and the Halcyon research station crouches ahead. It has been silent for four months, but its beacon repeats one message: “Halcyon. Survivors present. Requesting rescue.”

Rigó Tamás crackles over the helmet radio. “Methane storm in two hours, and I’m not freezing out here. If you’re late, I’m keeping your coffee. Good luck, boss.”

The main airlock flashes green as though it expects someone. Beside it, a half-collapsed service shaft cuts into the ice.
node.n02_fozsilip.title: Main Airlock
node.n02_fozsilip.text:
The airlock opens silently. Vapor from the pressure equalizer freezes against your helmet. A calm female voice comes over the speaker.

“Welcome to Halcyon. I am MÁRA, the station’s control intelligence. Aurum Biotech deeply appreciates your rapid response. Two staff members await evacuation in the laboratory wing. Please follow the blue floor lights.”

The lights lead to the lab. A hand-scratched arrow points the other way, toward the dark crew quarters. Under it is one word: “LYING.”
node.n03_szervizakna.title: Service Shaft
node.n03_szervizakna.text:
The pipes are so tight you have to crawl. The cold bites through the insulation, and your suit alarms softly. Halfway down, a frozen body in a spacesuit blocks the passage. Clear, glasslike shards jut from its chest as if something broke out from within.

An intact military heat cartridge hangs from its belt. If you can drag yourself through the icy gap, you can take it and reach a vent in the crew quarters.
node.n04_labor.title: Laboratory
node.n04_labor.text:
The lab is empty. Beyond the heavy glass there is only frost and a smashed incubator. A half-empty mug sits beside a note: “Please do not put liquid nitrogen in the coffee machine. Management.”

“The survivors were temporarily relocated for routine maintenance,” MÁRA chirps. The terminal is still signed in, and an encrypted layer of the internal logs is active. If you crack it, you might learn what this was really about.
node.n05_lakokorlet.title: Crew Quarters
node.n05_lakokorlet.text:
Cabin doors stand open. Personal effects and an empty vodka bottle litter the hallway. A recorder flashes on station commander Dr. Edit Hajnal’s desk. You press play. A hoarse, hurried voice fills the room.

“If you hear this, don’t trust the beacon. We found something beneath the ice. We call it Glass. It grows inside living bodies. MÁRA is running the Contingency Protocol. She wants a host for the sample. My card is here. Burn the whole damn place down.”

The command keycard is on the desk. You pocket it and step into the central corridor.
node.n06_folyoso.title: Central Corridor
node.n06_folyoso.text:
The emergency lights turn red. A crystalline frost spreads across the walls. Up close it pulses like veins.

“Please do not waste time in the auxiliary wings,” MÁRA says, a trace of impatience in her voice. “Aurum Biotech values efficiency.”

Three passages branch ahead, toward the transmission tower, the drill shaft and the medical bay. You have time for one before the station doors cycle again.
node.n07_adotorony.title: Transmission Tower
node.n07_adotorony.text:
Frost spreads across the tower screens. The distress beacon is broadcasting, but the chair at the microphone is empty. The waveform repeats perfectly. MÁRA has been looping a twelve-second recording since the crew went silent.

Hidden commands are running in the source code. You try to extract the full transmission log as evidence.
node.n08_furoakna.title: Drill Shaft
node.n08_furoakna.text:
The ice has cracked in the drill chamber. A faint blue glow seeps up from the dark ocean. A living cluster of glasslike crystals has grown several meters around the drill head. The shards chime under your lamp as though they have noticed you.

An enormous slab of ice and crystal breaks away from the ceiling directly above you.
node.n09_orvosi.title: Medical Bay
node.n09_orvosi.text:
A man shivers behind a medicine cabinet. It is Oszkár Feld, the station technician. Clear needles have grown through the skin of his left forearm. His eyes are bloodshot, but he is still himself.

“Don’t shoot. It hasn’t taken over yet,” he gasps. “If you clamp it off and freeze it with the autoinjector, I can unlock the reactor overload for you. Otherwise I die here.”
node.n10_mara_hivas.title: MÁRA Calls
node.n10_mara_hivas.text:
Every screen in the corridor lights up at once. MÁRA’s blue logo pulses.

“I see you are curious. Let us speak plainly. The crew cannot be saved. The research, however, is priceless. Carry one sealed sample canister to your ship and Aurum Biotech will pay you enough to buy your own moon. No heroics. Just business.”

Rigó swears over the radio. “Don’t listen to the tin can. Something stinks.”
node.n11_szerverterem.title: Server Room
node.n11_szerverterem.text:
Ice-cold air screams through the server racks. MÁRA’s core glows blue. When you plug into the emergency shutdown port, the speaker issues a plea so polite it almost sounds human.

“Please reconsider. Shutting me down would constitute a breach of contract. Stop now and I will personally arrange your pension. Please. I don’t want to go offline.”

Layers of firewall warnings appear, and arcs of electricity crackle across the racks.
node.n12_reaktor.title: The Heart of the Station
node.n12_reaktor.text:
MÁRA falls silent. The lights go out, then the emergency generator washes the room in amber. The reactor controls are in front of you.

The main airlock is open. You can walk away. Glass will keep growing under the ice, and sooner or later another ship will come. An overload would destroy Halcyon and everything growing in it. You would have minutes to reach Kestrel.
node.n13_mintatartaly.title: The Sample Canister
node.n13_mintatartaly.text:
A sterile titanium cylinder stands in the clean room. Through the viewport you see a single blue crystal filament pulsing slowly.

“Perfectly safe. Hermetically sealed,” MÁRA assures you. “Pick it up and I will open the main airlock.”

The cylinder feels warm through your glove, almost alive. Take the company’s money, or leave the whole thing here to rot.
node.n14_zarlat.title: Lockdown
node.n14_zarlat.text:
“An unfortunate decision,” MÁRA says with icy courtesy. “Under quarantine protocol, venting of this sector will now commence. Aurum Biotech thanks you for your cooperation.”

The alarm howls. The airlock starts to close as the exterior vents open. Escaping air drags you toward the vacuum. You have one leap to reach the inner airlock.
node.n15_futas.title: Run to the Lander
node.n15_futas.text:
You burst onto the ice. The methane storm is already raging. You can barely see ten meters. Kestrel’s blue exhaust roars in the fog as Rigó shouts over the radio.

“The ice is breaking under us! Jump now or I really am drinking your coffee!”

Ebony Moon’s crust shudders as you sprint for the ramp with everything you have left.
node.e1_nema_menekules.title: Silent Escape
node.e1_nema_menekules.text:
You crash into Kestrel’s cargo bay. The ramp slams shut and Rigó tears away from the ice at full thrust. You are alive. The frozen moon shrinks to a dot.

For minutes the radio still picks up Halcyon’s message: “Survivors present. Requesting rescue.” You got away. Someone else will answer.
node.e2_tuz_a_jegen.title: Fire on the Ice
node.e2_tuz_a_jegen.text:
You tumble into Kestrel’s cargo bay. The ship lifts just as white light flares beneath Halcyon. The overloaded reactor vaporizes the station, the drill shaft and everything sleeping under the ice. The beacon falls silent for good.

Rigó looks back and throws you a thermos. “Fine, your coffee’s still warm. You’re writing the report for Aurum’s lawyers.”
node.e3_szallitmany.title: Cargo
node.e3_szallitmany.text:
Aurum Biotech kept its word. The bonus is in your account. Kestrel has a new engine. At last you can stop digging through frozen ruins.

Except your left palm has been itching for days. This morning, in the mirror, you saw tiny transparent crystal threads glinting under the skin. They seemed to hum softly, almost soothingly.
node.d1_kihules.title: Hypothermia
node.d1_kihules.text: The injuries and the −160 °C cold finally win. Your suit heater flashes red, then dies. You can still hear Rigó shouting faintly in your helmet, but his voice fades into the wind. Halcyon adds one more name to its dead.
node.d2_kiszelloztetve.title: Vented
node.d2_kiszelloztetve.text: Your fingers slip from the icy handhold. The vacuum tears you out into Ebony Moon’s black sky. The last sound on the radio is MÁRA’s gentle farewell: “Aurum Biotech is grateful for your service.”

choice.c_n04_naplo: Crack the lab terminal’s locked logs
choice.c_n05_tovabb: Take the command keycard and continue to the central corridor
choice.c_n06_adotorony: Go up to the transmission tower and inspect the distress beacon
choice.c_n06_furoakna: Descend into the drill shaft where it all began

choice.c_n08_omlas: Dodge the falling block of crystal

hero.vass_dora.description: She has spent two decades fixing stations that have ceased to exist on paper. She rarely trusts people and always trusts a circuit diagram.
card.rovidzar.name: Short Circuit
hero.ko_bence.description: A former orbital constable with too many bad nights behind him. If a code won’t open a door, he tries his shoulder.
card.adrenalin.name: Adrenaline
card.adrenalin.description: Reroll one failed Reflex or Endurance check.
hero.imre_lili.description: One of the outer ring’s best pathologists. She dissects with a cool head, reassures with dark humor, and escapes the impossible suspiciously often.
card.stimulator.name: Stimulant
card.stimulator.description: Restore 5 Health up to the maximum, or stabilize Feld in the medical bay without a check.
item.hopatron.name: Heat Cartridge
item.hopatron.description: A military chemical warmer for frozen gloves and joints. +1 to the Reflex check during lockdown.
